hook_en: Ask Him to teach you His way. 🙏
reflect_en: David didn't ask for an easy road; he prayed, Teach me Your way, O LORD, and asked for an undivided heart. As this weekend begins, you can bring Him every scattered thought and pull of the week, and let gratitude gather your heart back to Him.
q_en: Where do you need God to show you His way right now?
x_en: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
tiktok: Pray this when your heart feels pulled in every direction 🙏 Psalm 86:11–12 — Give me an undivided heart
yt_title: Give Me an Undivided Heart | Psalm 86:11–12 #Shorts
li_open: Divided attention is one of a leader's quietest struggles.
li_quote: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
li_body: David asked God to teach him and to unite his heart before he promised to praise Him with all of it. Leaders who keep asking God for direction, and who make room to pray with their people about what really matters, lead with focus instead of being pulled in every direction.
hook_es: Pídele que te enseñe Su camino. 🙏
reflect_es: David no pidió un camino fácil; oró: Enséñame, oh Jehová, tu camino, y le pidió que consolidara su corazón. Al comenzar este fin de semana, puedes entregarle todo lo que te dispersó esta semana y alabarle con todo tu corazón.
q_es: ¿En qué área necesitas que Dios te muestre Su camino hoy?
x_es: Enséñame, oh Jehová, tu camino; caminaré yo en tu verdad: consolida mi corazón para que tema tu nombre.
